title: GraphQLResponse
description: Response from a GraphQL query execution

data.description: The data returned by the query. Structure mirrors the query shape. Contains a uiapi root object with query results.

query.description: Contains the query results keyed by object name. Each object result uses Relay-style pagination with edges and nodes.

errors.description: Errors encountered during query execution. Present alongside data if some fields failed but others succeeded.

extensions.description: Extension data provided by the server, including query cost and performance metrics.
